config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    sum(bytes_on_disk) AS size
FROM system.parts
config.name: 현재 사용 공간 (parts)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    sum(data_uncompressed_bytes) AS size
FROM system.parts
config.name: 미압축시 원본 디스크 크기 (parts)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    sum(rows) AS total_rows
FROM system.parts
config.name: 전체 데이터 행 (parts)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    round(
        sum(data_uncompressed_bytes)
        / nullIf(sum(data_compressed_bytes), 0),
        2
    ) AS compression_ratio
FROM system.parts
WHERE active = 1;
config.name: 압축률

config.sqlTemplate:
select
	sumIf(bytes_on_disk, active = 0) 
	/ 
	sum(bytes_on_disk)
    as dead_part_percent
FROM system.parts;
config.name: dead parts 비율 (parts)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    (total_space - free_space) / total_space AS used_ratio
FROM system.disks
WHERE name = 'default'
config.name: 디스크 사용률 (default)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    free_space - keep_free_space AS writable_free
FROM system.disks
WHERE name = 'default'
config.name: 쓰기 가능 여유 공간 (default)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    database,
    sum(bytes_on_disk) AS bytes_on_disk
FROM system.parts
GROUP BY
    database
config.name: DB별 디스크 사용량 (parts)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    database || '.' ||  table,
    sum(bytes_on_disk) AS bytes_on_disk
FROM system.parts
GROUP BY
    database,
    table
config.name: 테이블별 디스크 사용량 (parts)
active/inactive 디스크 사용량 (parts)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    disk_name,
    sum(bytes_on_disk) AS bytes_on_disk
FROM system.parts
GROUP BY
    disk_name
config.name: 디스크별 사용량 (parts)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts,
    disk_name,
    sum(size_in_bytes) AS moved_bytes
FROM system.part_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
    AND event_type = 'MovePart'
GROUP BY
    ts,
    disk_name
ORDER BY ts
LIMIT 1000
config.name: 콜드 티어 이동량 (MovePart)
